intent: Coordinate an independent release-level audit using the auditor role and the audit strategy, then write a conformity report without remediation.
steps: Delegate measurement to the auditor role with clean, sufficient context containing authoritative intent, repository revision, evidence and runtime observations
Do not prime the auditor with conclusions such as everything passed
Execute the configured audit strategy passes against the release candidate scope
Write the audit report and findings to their designated governance locations
Classify each conclusion as expected and observed, expected but not demonstrated, observed but not specified, contradiction, or unknown
Create remediation as separate Work Units when findings require code changes; re-verify and re-audit after remediation
invariants: The auditor must not remediate the code under evaluation
Measurement is independent of implementer self-report
Remediation is out of scope for the audit procedure itself
